definitions.short: properly, a vault or cell (with an arch); by implication, a prison
definitions.full: H2588. chanuth [ חָנוּת ] noun feminine cell (as having curved or vaulted roof, arched ; see Thes Gf, and compare Aramaic vaulted room ) — הַחֲנֻיּוֺת Jer 37:16 (|| הַבּוֺר בֵּית ).
